newsitem.title: USA: Glickman names panel to review fed ag research.
newsitem.headline: Glickman names panel to review fed ag research.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman Wednesday appointed a 15-member panel to review federally financed agricultural research facilities and come up with a 10-year strategic plan in two years.

"Limited federal dollars and shifts in national research priorities make this the optimum time for reevaluating our research capacity and streamlining our research network," Glickman said in a statement.
USDA has 104 Agricultural Research Service locations and the Forest Service has about 76 facilities. Federal funds have also supported research facility construction at universities.

Tom Urban, CEO, Pioneer Hybrid International and faculty, Harvard University Business School will chair the panel and Bruce Andrews, director, Oregon Department of Agriculture will serve as vice-chair, USDA said.
The panel was created by the 1996 Farm Bill.
